text:
morgan: FYI starting staged rollout for dynamic-routing-v2. Will toggle feature flag dynamic-routing-v2-ff in us-east first, change window 2h. Release doc: https://go/release/2026-03-dyn-route

deploy-bot: Canary created cr-9420. t0 -> 1% in us-east. Dash https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-9420

lee: Rollout plan: 1% -> 5% (t+10m hold 15m) -> 20% (t+40m hold 30m) -> manual 100%. Triggers: p95 +120ms, error >0.3%, token throughput +35%

sam: rollback pin ready: tag=v1-pin-2026-03-21. Rollback cmd in runbook: `/ff set dynamic-routing-v2-ff 0% && route-pin set default router v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-21`

ops: Noted slight cpu bump on us-east-1b early canary. If sustained >15m we'll AZ-pin that zone to v1 instead of full rollback. Command: `/route override --az us-east-1b --service router --pin v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-21`

oncall-erin: Oncall here. I'll run synthetics and watch business KPIs. Page me for any kill-switch hits.

deploy-bot: t+12m metrics: p95 +18ms, errors nominal. Advancing to 5%

lee: seeing a persistent tail on us-east-1b for 12m. Apply AZ override now and exclude from ramp.

ops: AZ override applied: us-east-1b pinned to v1. Canary metrics excluding pinned AZ stable. Holding at 5% per plan.

morgan: Good catch. Keep 30m stable after 20% before manual approve. No other infra deploys in window.

deploy-bot: At t+55m reached 20% holdpoint; metrics healthy. Manual approval required to go to 100%

oncall-erin: Synthetics green, business KPIs stable. Approve final step in 5m if no regressions.

sam: Approving. Executing `/ff roll dynamic-routing-v2-ff --region us-east --target 100`

deploy-bot: Flag at 100% in us-east. Canary cr-9420 closed success. Global roll scheduled in next hour with same holds. Runbook annotated with AZ-override and rollback tag v1-pin-2026-03-21 (held 72h).
